Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from the game. India Women win it comprehensively. West Indies Women have a lot to work on as they have failed to win a single game in this series. The final will be now played between South Africa Women and India Women on Thursday, 2nd of February. It will begin at 6.30 pm IST (1.00 pm GMT). Do join us a bit early for the build-up as well. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Deepti Sharma is the Player of the Match for her spell of (4-2-11-3). She says that everyone has faith in her and she just bowls simple. Adds that she had practiced and everyone supports her so she can bowl freely. Ends by saying that she enjoys bowling and seeing the team win.

Harmanpreet Kaur the skipper of India Women says that they bowled well but could have done better. Adds that going forward they will look to improve and their batting was good. Says that the next game is a great opportunity to try their best combination and give their best. Ends by saying that she is happy to watch their team win.

Hayley Matthews the skipper of West Indies Women says that they need a lot to work on but some positives to take away as the U19 girls got a chance to play. Adds that it brings a huge smile to watch them play and have them in the squad. Ends by saying that cricket is a sport and they will keep on improving.
Presentations coming up...

Earlier in the game, the West Indies Women score 94 runs in their allotted 20 overs. Their skipper scored 34 runs but the other batters kept on losing wickets. Later, Zaida James added crucial 21 runs on the board. Deepti Sharma was the pick of the bowlers with a spell of 4-2-11-3. Pooja Vastrakar bagged two wickets whilst Rajeshwari Gayakwa had one in her kitty. The rest of the bowlers remained wicketless.

To be honest, West Indies Women hardly stood a chance to win this game and were under the pump right from the word go. Their bowlers had nothing much to defend, but they did give it a try. They got an early wicket but failed to shrug off Jemimah Rodrigues. Shamilia Connell and Hayley Matthews got a wicket each for their team.

Well, it was certainly a one-way traffic through in this dead rubber. India Women were already into the finals, and a win in this game gave them a spur to play in. West Indies Women will be hugely disappointed as they have failed to win even a single game in this series. India Women got off to a steady start and lost an early wicket of Smriti Mandhana. They never looked in trouble tough, as Jemimah Rodrigues carried on with her flurry of runs. Later, Harmanpreet Kaur joined hands with her and finished off the game. Jemimah Rodrigues scored 42 runs and Harmanpreet Kaur scored 32.
On a length and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one. India Women beat West Indies Women by 8 wickets!
Lands it on off, Jemimah Rodrigues cuts it to point for one.
Bowls it on off, Jemimah Rodrigues pushes it to deep covers for a brace.
Slightly shorter one, Harmanpreet Kaur guides it to backward point for one.
On a length and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues eases it to point for one.
FOUR! SMOKED! Fuller again on off, Harmanpreet Kaur advances and lofts it just over the mid-on fielder as the ball races down to the long-on region for a boundary. Just 5 needed now.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur uses her feet and hits it through the left of the cover fielder for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it to covers.
Full and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues drives it to deep covers for one.
Slower and shorter outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues guides it past the short third fielder for a couple. A fumble allows the batters to complete the second.
Harmanpreet Kaur advances and takes it on the full, drills it to deep extra covers for one.
Short of a length outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur moves across and pulls it to deep square leg for one.
On a length on off stump, Harmanpreet Kaur defends it back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur rides on top of it and guides it to point.
Length ball on off, Jemimah Rodrigues works it to mid-wicket and takes off for a quick single.
On a good length outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur punches it to deep point for one.
Back of a length around off, Jemimah Rodrigues rides on top and tucks it to square leg for one.
FOUR! CLUBBED! Full and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur moves across and lofts it to the wide long-on region for a boundary. Excellent batting.
Good length comes back into the batter, Harmanpreet Kaur is cramped for room and drops it onto the pitch.
On a good length on the off stump. Jemimah Rodrigues drops it to point and takes off for a quick single.
Short of a length outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues taps it to point.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Short and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues cuts it off the backfoot as the ball races through the backward point region for a boundary.
Short and slower outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues looks to run in down to third man but gets beaten by lack of pace.

Drinks! India Women are steadily getting towards their target and are looking comfortable in the middle. They need 30 runs in 60 balls with 8 wickets to spare. To be honest, West Indies Women need something special to get back into this game. Aaliyah Alleyne comes into the attack!

Quicker outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur drops it to covers and takes off for a single. A throw from the covers and a deflection off the stumps at the non-striker's end allows the batters to take the second run. 10 coming off the over.
Flatter outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur guides it past short third fielder and scampers for a couple.
Short and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Tad short on the pads, Harmanpreet Kaur tucks it to square leg for one.
Full toss again and Harmanpreet Kaur hits it to deep extra covers and another fumble lets Harmanpreet Kaur return for the second.
A low full toss outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur slices it through covers and a fumble allows her to come back for two.
Tosses it up on the leg peg, Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Tosses up on off, Harmanpreet Kaur moves to play the paddle sweep and misses.
Short on off, Jemimah Rodrigues goes back and tucks it to onside for a single.
Harmanpreet Kaur goes back and eases it through point region for single.
Full and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues looks to play the paddle sweep, misses and wears on her pad. Jemimah Rodrigues takes a leg bye as the ball deflects off her pads.
FOUR! HAMMERED! Short and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues goes back and pulls it powerfully through the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. Great SHOT!
Full and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues advances and gets an inside edge to square leg for a single.
Harmanpreet Kaur plays it with the turn and works it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! ELEGANT! Full and wide outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur waits and leans into it to drive it through covers for a boundary. Excellent placement and timing.
Full and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur prods forward and defends.
Tossed up on off, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it to mid-off.
The skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur walks in.

OUT! GONE! CAUGHT! Flighted on off, Harleen Deol uses her feet but does not get the elevation. She hits it into the hands of Shabika Gajnabi at mid-off who takes it with ease. Hayley Matthews takes her first of the game as India Women lose their second.
Commentary.Howout: c Shabika Gajnabi b Hayley Matthews

Commentary.Commentary: Tad short outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues advances and guides it to short third.
Full and down the leg, Jemimah Rodrigues sweeps it to wide of the fine leg fielder for a couple. The fielder dives to her right and saves 2 for her side.
Full and on the stumps, Harleen Deol sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Full and on the leg peg, Harleen Deol works it to mid -wicket.
Tossed outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues drives it to deep extra cover for a single.
Afy Fletcher starts off with a short ball on off, Harleen Deol plays off the backfoot to covers and a fumble allows Harleen Deol to sneak a run.
Drifting again into the batter, Jemimah Rodrigues presses forward and blocks it out.
Drifter outside off, goes on with the arm. Jemimah Rodrigues prods forward and defends.
Full and on off, Harleen Deol gets a leading edge as she chips it to mid-on and it falls short of the fielder. A misfield allows the batter to take one.
Floated again and Harleen Deol drives it to mid-off.
Tosses it up outside off, Harleen Deol leans forward and drives it to covers.
Hayley Matthews starts off with a length ball around off, and Harleen Deol goes back and defends.
Bowls it outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues slaps it straight to the point fielder.
FOUR! Fine shot. Slightly shorter and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues rocks back and cuts it uppishly through point for a boundary!
Angles it in from outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues defends it back.
Bowls it on off, Jemimah Rodrigues punches it to the fielder at point.
Similar delivery, Harleen Deol guides it to point for one.
Slightly shorter and on off, Harleen Deol slaps it to the woman at backward point.
On a length and on off, Harleen Deol pushes it to covers for one.
Fuller and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues drives it to the wide of mid off for one.
Slightly shorter one, Jemimah Rodrigues slaps it to deep backward point for a brace.
Bowls it on off, some extra bounce, Jemimah Rodrigues fends it to short covers.
Lands it on off, Harleen Deol eases it to point for one.
FOUR! Harleen Deol joins the party now. Fuller and on the leg, Harleen Deol hangs back and flicks it through the square leg. Two fielders chase but the ball wins the race.
FOUR! Pulled away. This one lands shorter and on leg, Jemimah Rodrigues swivels and pulls it through square leg as the ball races away from the fence line a rocket.
Lands it on leg, Jemimah Rodrigues eases it back. Dot.
FOUR! Well timed! Fuller and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues gets on her knee and caresses it through extra covers for a boundary!
Wide! Lands it wide outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues lets it be.
Fuller and on off, Harleen Deol pushes it to short covers and scampers through for a single!
Bowls it on middle, Harleen Deol defends it back.
Fuller and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues pushes it to point for one.
Lands it on leg, Harleen Deol flicks it to deep square leg for a brace.
Harleen Deol walks in.

OUT! TIMBER! Shamilia Connell gets the big fish here. Bowls it on a length, it shapes out, and nips it again, Smriti Mandhana looks to block it but gets beaten on the inside edge as the ball rattles the bails off. Smriti Mandhana walks back!
Slightly shorter one, Jemimah Rodrigues slaps it to backward point for one. Good fielding there!
On a length, angling in, Jemimah Rodrigues blocks it back.
Another dot ball as this is played towards the woman at mid on.
Slower one, angling in, Jemimah Rodrigues fends it to point for none.
Wide! Lands it wide outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues lets it go.
Shamilia Connell to bowl from the other end.
On a length and outside off, Smriti Mandhana offers no stroke. Ends with a dot.
FOUR! Nicely played. Errs her line and bowls it on leg, Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary!
Nice and full, on off, Smriti Mandhana eases it to the woman at point.
A low full toss, some width to offer, Jemimah Rodrigues guides it to covers for one. She gets off the mark!
Bowls it outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues blocks it to covers.
Bowls a fuller one on off, Smriti Mandhana taps it to covers and gets off the mark. They cross.
